column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:math module
# Loadable module. Import binds the `math` namespace, then words are
# called via dot-access: `import "aql:math-util"  MathUtil.word args`. Words
# operate on Numbers; results are Float for the transcendental/root
# functions and Integer for the rounding family applied to Integers.
# the rounding family is total over the whole Number family (NUR008 fix):
# an Integer is already integral — identity, keeping its type.

column3: a finite Float is not NaN

column1: # remainder is the IEEE round-to-nearest remainder — distinct from `mod`.
# round-even ties to even (IEEE default); round ties away from zero.
# fma: a*b + c with a single rounding (forward form)
# min / max ignore NaN and are order-independent (IEEE-2008 minNum/maxNum).
# §6  negative — a namespace word is undefined until the module is imported
# §9  BigInteger / BigDecimal coverage — abs / negate / sign and min / max
# are TOTAL over the whole Number family (a Big argument previously raised
# uncalled_function). abs / negate keep the exact Big type; sign yields an
# Integer; min / max return the selected OPERAND unchanged.

column3: abs of a BigInteger stays BigInteger
abs of a BigDecimal stays BigDecimal
sign of a BigInteger is an Integer
Big abs preserves the exact type
min of two BigIntegers returns the operand
max of two BigIntegers returns the operand
max across BigInteger and Integer keeps the exact operand
min across BigInteger and Integer keeps the exact operand
min preserves the operand's exact type
